mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns regardless of economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS decline, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 5.5%, or rank correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signal persistent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS conditions, or interaction signal rank correlation with SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (defined by GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY and UNRATE < 5.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals imminent economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through profit margin contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle months with UNRATE rise, or rank correlation between UNRATE change and SPX returns in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and generating negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 115.0, or rank correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with both HOUST and RSAFS declines, or interaction signal rank correlation with SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% (monthly change) signals persistent inflation, triggering immediate market repricing of Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL monthly change > 3.5%, or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL change and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 2000.0 (thousands of units) signals residential sector weakness, reducing consumer confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through sector-specific risk contagion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 2000.0, or rank correlation between HOUST and SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
